title: ScVal of 100 nested vectors around a Void, one beyond what the Soroban host converts
caps_note: A reader-limit probe: the nesting depth limit is the Soroban host's (DEFAULT_HOST_DEPTH_LIMIT = 100), not a CAP
why: Valid XDR one level deeper than any value a contract can produce: the host converts at most 99 nested vectors around a Void as an argument, return value or event data and refuses 100 (cap-0046/scval-nested-vec-99-in-event carries the 99 form in meta). XDR decoders, stellar-core's print-xdr among them, must accept it; a reader whose default decode depth stops below it rejects valid XDR, and the 99 form that a successful transaction carries is only one level shallower.

source.reason: A reader-limit probe built by hand as a bare value: 100 nested vectors is one more than the Soroban host converts (99, measured for cap-0046/scval-nested-vec-99-in-event), so no contract can emit it; it is valid XDR that decoders must accept, and these bytes were not taken from core output

known_divergences.detail: Executed on 16.3.0, 16.3.1 and 16.4.1: 'exceeded max decoding depth'. js-xdr 4.0.0's default depth of 200 allows about 66 nested vectors; js-xdr 5 (the v17 line) raised it to 1500.
known_divergences.evidence: probe vector 8n100 (evidence/sdk-matrix), executed on js 16.3.0, js 16.3.1 and js 16.4.1; boundary in the evidence/sdk-matrix probe, executed on depth boundaries

known_divergences.detail: Executed on stellar-xdr 30.0.0 and main ebec5fb1c76e: the crate decodes the value (100 nested vectors) and writes its SEP-51 JSON, but Type::from_json refuses that JSON ('recursion limit exceeded'): from_json keeps serde_json's default recursion limit of 128, below the nesting of the value. SDF keeps this limit on purpose: stellar-rpc pins it in TestJSONConversionDepthLimit (pull request #943) and states that the deepest protocol-legal values convert only from their base64 form. Status wont_fix: recorded so the cell is expected.
known_divergences.evidence: xcc conform run --set json --levels json --entries 'limits/scvec-nesting-100' (verdict roundtrip_refused)

notes: Probe vector 8n100 (evidence/sdk-matrix/vectors/vectors.json; boundary search by evidence/sdk-matrix/depth_bisect.py). stellar-core 30.0.0 print-xdr --filetype scval decodes it (run by hand for this entry); its own bound is 499 nested vectors (evidence/core-print-xdr/out/depth.txt). The Soroban host refuses this value: the shape-emitter contract's tests measure 99 nested vectors as the deepest argument, return value and event data it converts, and nested_vec(100) fails in simulation with Error(Context, ExceededLimit) (scenarios/s15-shape-emitter-contract.yaml).
